title: Global generation is stalkwise surjectivity
statement:
Let $T$ be a scheme, $\Lambda$ a commutative ring and $F$ a sheaf
of $\Lambda_T$-modules on $T_{\Et}$, with evaluation morphism
$\bigoplus_{s\in\Gamma(T_{\Et},F)}\underline{\Lambda}\to F$ of
[def-kun-global-generated]. Then the following are equivalent:

1. **(1)** $F$ is globally generated, i.e. the evaluation morphism
is an epimorphism of sheaves;
1. **(2)** the evaluation morphism is surjective on every geometric
stalk of $T$.

proof.text: Write e for the evaluation morphism of [def-kun-global-generated]. If e is epi, the geometric stalk functor preserves it because it is left adjoint to the skyscraper sheaf functor. A module morphism is epi precisely when its underlying function is surjective (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective). This proves the forward implication at every geometric point of [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. The needed smaller limits of modules are supplied by hasLimitsOfSizeShrink.

Conversely, specialize the assumed surjectivity to the algebraic closure of the residue field at each x in T. Convert each fibre map to an epimorphism using ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective. The conservative family underlying [lemma-weil-pbc-geometric-stalk-conservative] is isConservativeFamilyOfPoints_ulift_pointSmallEtale T. Apply its jointlyReflectEpimorphisms theorem directly to module-valued sheaves. At x, use naturality of uliftSheafFiberIso to identify the lifted map, up to pre- and postcomposition by isomorphisms, with the known epic unlifted map. Thus every lifted fibre map is epi, and joint reflection implies e is epi. This is global generation by [def-kun-global-generated].

proof_origin.place: Proof specialized directly to ModuleCat using the existing geometric conservative family, joint reflection of epimorphisms, the skyscraper adjunction and the universe-lift fibre comparison (M9 stage 3).
